recipes.title: Balance sheet accounts without a reconciliation or supporting schedule
inputs: Reconciliation workpapers kept outside Dime
recipes.prompt: Which balance sheet accounts have balances but no reconciliation or supporting schedule for the last closed month?

setupQuestions.q: Which balance sheet accounts need a reconciliation or schedule every month?
Where are reconciliations and schedules kept when they are not in Dime (folder, workbook, system)?

recipes.title: Recurring vendors with no expense this month
inputs: Vendor contracts or recurring invoices
recipes.prompt: Which recurring vendors had expenses in each of the prior three months but no expense recorded this month?

setupQuestions.q: Which vendors bill quarterly or annually, or are known to be seasonal, and should be left out?

recipes.title: Clearing account items open more than 30 days
inputs: Bank statements or processor settlement reports
recipes.prompt: Show all clearing account items older than 30 days and explain what each appears to relate to.

setupQuestions.q: Which accounts are clearing or suspense accounts?
How many days should an item normally take to clear?

recipes.title: Vendors coded inconsistently across accounts or departments
inputs: Approved account and department coding guide
recipes.prompt: Identify vendors whose expenses are coded inconsistently across accounts or departments over the last quarter.

setupQuestions.q: Which vendors are allowed to be coded to more than one account or department (and which)?

recipes.title: Fixed assets without depreciation and inactive CIP
inputs: Fixed asset register kept outside Dime
recipes.prompt: Which fixed assets have been placed in service but have no depreciation recorded, and which construction-in-progress items have been inactive for more than 90 days?

setupQuestions.q: Which accounts hold construction in progress?

recipes.title: Invoices whose service period differs from the invoice month
inputs: Customer invoices or billing schedules not attached in Dime
recipes.prompt: Which customer invoices have service periods that differ from the invoice month, and what amounts relate to each service month?

recipes.title: AP balance by vendor at each month end with debit balances and duplicate vendor names
recipes.prompt: Show the AP balance by vendor at each month end this year. Flag vendors with debit balances and vendor records that look like the same vendor under two names.

recipes.title: Possible duplicate bills or payments
recipes.prompt: Find possible duplicate bills or payments this year: same vendor and the same or nearly the same amount within 30 days.

setupQuestions.q: Which vendors legitimately bill the same amount repeatedly (rent, subscriptions) and should be excluded?

recipes.title: Card transactions uncategorised or personal-looking
recipes.prompt: List card transactions in the last closed month that are uncategorized or look personal (gym, groceries, entertainment with no business note).

setupQuestions.q: What does the card policy say about receipts, categories and business notes?
Who holds a card and who approves their spend?

recipes.title: Bank statement to general ledger reconciliation for the last closed month
inputs: Bank statements, one per account in scope
recipes.prompt: Reconcile each bank statement to the general ledger for the last closed month. Match transactions and explain every outstanding difference.

setupQuestions.q: Which bank accounts are reconciled every month?
Below what amount is an unexplained difference recorded as a note rather than an exception?

recipes.title: Corporate card and expense platform reconciliation to the ledger
inputs: Card platform export
recipes.prompt: Reconcile corporate card and expense-platform transactions to the ledger, including refunds, fees and settlements. Identify missing or duplicate postings.

setupQuestions.q: Which ledger accounts does each card or expense platform post to (card liability or clearing, fee expense, settlement bank account)?

recipes.title: Vendor bill in the AP subledger with no general ledger posting
inputs: Integration event logs for the accounts payable connection
recipes.prompt: Investigate why a vendor bill appears in the AP subledger but its expected posting is missing from the general ledger.

recipes.title: Payroll funding, payroll journal entries and bank withdrawals by pay period
inputs: Payroll gross-to-net report for the pay period
Payroll funding report for the pay period
Bank statement covering the pay date
recipes.prompt: Reconcile payroll funding, payroll journal entries and actual bank withdrawals by pay period. Explain differences caused by deposits, fees or timing.

setupQuestions.q: Which ledger account is the payroll clearing or payroll funding account?
What is the pay calendar (frequency, pay dates, the lag between period end and pay date)?

recipes.title: Retirement contributions withheld versus remitted to the plan
inputs: Payroll deduction export for the pay period (employee and employer retirement lines)
Plan remittance report for the same pay period
recipes.prompt: Reconcile employee and employer retirement contributions withheld through payroll to amounts remitted to the plan. Flag missed or duplicate deductions.

setupQuestions.q: Who is the retirement plan provider or recordkeeper?
What is the employer match formula (for example 100% of the first 3% and 50% of the next 2%)?
Which ledger account holds retirement contributions payable?

recipes.title: Balance in the AP foreign-exchange account: realized, unrealized or unexplained
inputs: FX gains and losses report and revaluation runs for the period
recipes.prompt: Investigate the balance in the AP foreign-exchange account. Trace the underlying transactions and determine whether differences are realized, unrealized or unexplained.

setupQuestions.q: Which ledger accounts hold foreign-exchange gains and losses (realized and unrealized) for payables?
Which exchange-rate source and rate date does the entity use for bills, payments and month-end revaluation?

recipes.title: Intercompany receivables and payables by entity pair, invoice and currency
inputs: Intercompany matrix and reconciliation for the period
recipes.prompt: Reconcile intercompany receivables and payables by entity pair, invoice and currency, and explain differences before consolidation.

setupQuestions.q: Which entity pairs trade with each other (parent and subsidiary, subsidiary and subsidiary)?
Which ledger accounts are intercompany receivable and payable in each entity?
How are intercompany balances in different currencies translated and where do translation differences go?

recipes.title: Customer contract terms and billing schedules versus invoices and payments
inputs: Customer contracts and billing schedules
recipes.prompt: Compare customer contract terms and billing schedules to actual invoices and payments. Identify missing, duplicate or incorrectly timed billings.

recipes.title: Customer funds and payment clearing accounts to external statements and the GL
inputs: Processor settlement report for the period
Stripe reconciliation held in Dime
recipes.prompt: Reconcile opening balances and current activity in customer funds or payment clearing accounts to external statements and the GL.

setupQuestions.q: Which accounts are clearing or suspense accounts?
Which payment processors settle into the clearing accounts (and which account each one uses)?

recipes.title: Migrated ledger validation against the prior accounting system
inputs: Prior system trial balance as of the cutover date
Prior system balance sheet and profit and loss as of the cutover date
Prior system open AR and AP agings as of the cutover date
Prior system bank balances or bank reconciliations as of the cutover date
recipes.prompt: Validate a newly migrated ledger against the prior accounting system using trial balance, financial statements, open AR/AP and bank balances.

setupQuestions.q: How do the prior system's accounts map to Dime's chart of accounts (a mapping table or the rule used)?
What is the cutover date (the as-of date the migrated balances represent)?
What difference per account is accepted as rounding (0 means penny-exact)?

recipes.title: Prepaid expense schedule tied to the prepaid GL balance
inputs: Prepaid expense schedule for the period
recipes.prompt: Tie the prepaid expense schedule to the prepaid GL balance at the end of the last closed month and explain any variance item by item.

setupQuestions.q: Which ledger account (or accounts) holds prepaid expenses?

recipes.title: Invoice to payment matching for one selected vendor
recipes.prompt: For a selected vendor, match every invoice this year to its payment(s). Flag split payments, overpayments, possible duplicate payments and payments coded to different accounts.

setupQuestions.q: Which vendor should be matched (name or vendor id)?
Which payment methods does this vendor get paid by (ACH, check, wire, card)?

recipes.title: Monthly balance sheet reconciliation package
inputs: Prior month reconciliation workpapers
recipes.prompt: Prepare a monthly balance sheet reconciliation package with account rollforwards, supporting transactions, aging and unresolved items.

recipes.title: Invoices received after month-end for prior-period expenses not accrued
inputs: Bills received after the period end up to the close cutoff
recipes.prompt: Review invoices received after month-end and identify expenses relating to the prior period that have not been accrued.

setupQuestions.q: How many days after month-end are invoices still reviewed for the prior period (the close cutoff)?
Up to what amount may an accrual with a stated service period be proposed for one-click approval (tier A)?
Which ledger account holds accrued expenses?

recipes.title: Professional services time entries into the vendor accrual workbook
inputs: Itemized professional services invoices with time entries
Vendor accrual workbook
recipes.prompt: Extract time entries from professional services invoices, separate work date from invoice date, and update the existing vendor accrual workbook.

recipes.title: Prepaid expense rollforward from invoices and service dates
inputs: Vendor invoices and service agreements for prepaid items
recipes.prompt: Build a prepaid expense rollforward from invoices and contractual service dates. Calculate current-month amortization and remaining balances.

setupQuestions.q: Below what amount is an invoice expensed when paid rather than set up as a prepaid or an asset?
How are prepaids amortized (straight-line by month, by day, half-month convention)?
Which ledger account (or accounts) holds prepaid expenses?

recipes.title: Payroll journal entry from the gross-to-net report
inputs: Gross-to-net payroll export for the pay period
Payroll account and department mapping workbook
Payroll funding report for the pay period
recipes.prompt: Prepare the monthly payroll journal entry from the gross-to-net payroll report using approved account and department mappings.

setupQuestions.q: Which ledger account and department does each payroll line (wages, employer taxes, benefits, withholdings, net pay) post to?
Which ledger account is the payroll clearing or payroll funding account?

recipes.title: Month-end payroll accrual for days worked but not yet paid
inputs: Payroll calendar for the year
Payroll register for the last pay run before period end
recipes.prompt: Calculate the month-end payroll accrual for days worked but not yet paid, and prepare the reversing entry.

setupQuestions.q: What is the pay calendar (frequency, pay dates, the lag between period end and pay date)?

recipes.title: Fixed asset and construction-in-progress review with depreciation
inputs: Fixed asset and CIP workbook with in-service evidence
recipes.prompt: Review the fixed asset and construction-in-progress schedules. Identify assets ready for service, calculate depreciation under approved policies and propose entries.

setupQuestions.q: Below what amount is an invoice expensed when paid rather than set up as a prepaid or an asset?
What useful life applies to each asset class?
Which depreciation method and convention apply (straight-line, mid-month, half-year)?
Which accounts hold construction in progress?

recipes.title: Monthly close status report
inputs: Close checklist kept outside Dime
recipes.prompt: Prepare a monthly close status report using the close checklist, posted entries and reconciliation evidence. Identify outstanding dependencies.

recipes.title: Month-end audit support package
inputs: Audit engagement artifacts and request list
Report packages for the period
Document vault files for the period
Reconciliations and schedules kept outside Dime
recipes.prompt: Compile a month-end audit support package from the trial balance, account schedules, reconciliations and journal-entry support.

setupQuestions.q: How does the auditor want the package laid out (one file per account, one binder, their request list numbering)?
Which accounts does the package cover? Leave blank for every balance sheet account with a balance.

recipes.title: First-pass general ledger review against the prior month
recipes.prompt: Do a first pass review of the last closed month's general ledger compared with the prior month. Flag unusual coding, possible duplicates, balances with the wrong sign, entries with no description and anything that looks out of place for this business.

setupQuestions.q: Below what amount should a ledger line not be flagged?
How many review items at most should the first pass list (ranked by size)?

recipes.title: Fixed asset additions against the capitalization threshold and a depreciation recalculation
inputs: Fixed asset register and depreciation schedule
General ledger for fixed asset and expense accounts
Fixed asset register kept outside Dime
recipes.prompt: Review fixed asset additions this year against the capitalization threshold in policy: list capitalized items below it and expensed items above it, and recalculate the last closed month's depreciation by asset from in service date and useful life compared with what was booked.

setupQuestions.q: Below what amount is an invoice expensed when paid rather than set up as a prepaid or an asset?
What useful life applies to each asset class?
Which depreciation method and convention apply (straight-line, mid-month, half-year)?

recipes.title: Deferred revenue rollforward by customer tied to the GL
inputs: Revenue recognition waterfall and contract balances
Invoices and AR aging for the month
General ledger for the deferred revenue accounts
recipes.prompt: Roll forward deferred revenue by customer for the last closed month (opening, billed, recognized, closing) and tie the total to the GL.

setupQuestions.q: Which GL accounts hold deferred revenue?

recipes.title: Onboarding assessment of the books with a draft client request list
inputs: Bank accounts, statements and reconciliations
General ledger and chart of accounts
Document vault files and open document requests
recipes.prompt: Assess these books as if onboarding a new client: which accounts are unreconciled, which months are missing statements, what looks miscoded, and draft the document request list to send the client.

setupQuestions.q: What does the client do, who kept the books before, and what is known about their condition?
Which months should the assessment cover (default: January 1 of the current year to the last closed month)?

recipes.title: Monthly consolidated management reporting with commentary
inputs: Consolidation runs for the period
Report packages and realtime statements per entity
Flux analysis for the period against the prior month
recipes.prompt: Prepare monthly consolidated management reporting with income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and explanations of material changes.

setupQuestions.q: Which entities roll up to the parent, in what currency, and what eliminations apply?
Above what change (in reporting currency) does a line need an explanation?
Which KPIs appear on the front page and how is each defined?

recipes.title: Budget versus actual by department and vendor with variance drivers
inputs: Budget by department and budget versus actual
Expense transactions by department and vendor
Budget workbook
recipes.prompt: Compare actual expenses to budget by department and vendor. Identify the drivers of significant variances and distinguish timing from ongoing cost changes.

setupQuestions.q: Which budget version is the comparison against (name or year, and whether reforecasts replace it)?
Above what variance (amount) does a line need a driver?

recipes.title: Month-over-month payroll and contractor expense bridge
inputs: Payroll register for the month and the prior month
Headcount report by month
Contractor invoices and bills for the month and the prior month
recipes.prompt: Explain the change in payroll and contractor expenses month over month, separating headcount, rate changes, one-time costs and timing.

recipes.title: 13-week cash forecast update
inputs: Bank balances, AR aging, AP aging and the cash forecast
Existing 13-week cash forecast workbook
Payroll schedule
recipes.prompt: Update the 13-week cash forecast using current bank balances, open invoices, bills, payroll and recurring contractual commitments.

setupQuestions.q: How many days after the due date do customers pay on average?
Which recurring contractual payments are not in AP yet (rent, debt service, insurance) with amount and day of month?
Below what cash balance should a week be flagged?

recipes.title: Why operating cash flow differs from net income this month
inputs: Realtime statement of cash flows, balance sheet and profit and loss
recipes.prompt: Explain why operating cash flow differs from net income this month using working capital and noncash movements.

setupQuestions.q: Which balance sheet accounts belong to each cash flow line (operating, investing, financing) when Dime's default mapping is not right?

recipes.title: Proposed payment run for the next seven days
inputs: Open bills with approval status and due dates
Bank balances and payment history
recipes.prompt: Prepare a proposed payment run for the next seven days, considering due dates, available cash, approvals and duplicate payment risk.

setupQuestions.q: What are the payment rules (pay on due date, take discounts, hold unapproved bills, pay by ACH unless the vendor requires check)?
What cash balance must remain after the run?
Which vendors are paid first when cash is short (payroll providers, landlords, critical suppliers)?

recipes.title: Indirect-method cash flow statement rebuilt and reconciled to the system report
inputs: Realtime statement of cash flows, opening and closing balance sheets and profit and loss
recipes.prompt: Rebuild the last closed month's cash flow statement using the indirect method from the balance sheet and income statement, compare it with the system's cash flow report, and explain every difference.

setupQuestions.q: Which balance sheet accounts belong to each cash flow line (operating, investing, financing) when Dime's default mapping is not right?

recipes.title: Vendors paid by ACH, check or wire for 1099 review
inputs: Vendor W-9s not stored in Dime
recipes.prompt: List vendors paid this year by ACH, check or wire (not card), with totals, for 1099 review by the tax preparer, and flag vendors with no tax ID on file.

setupQuestions.q: What is the 1099 reporting threshold for the year (confirmed by the tax preparer)?

recipes.title: Customer contract review under ASC 606 and ASC 842
inputs: Contract record and revenue recognition schedule in Dime
Customer contract
Amendments and side letters
recipes.prompt: Review a customer contract and amendments against ASC 606 and ASC 842. Summarize relevant terms, accounting alternatives, missing facts and a preliminary conclusion.

setupQuestions.q: Which revenue and lease accounting policies has the entity adopted (practical expedients, portfolio approach, materiality)?
Who signs off accounting conclusions for this entity?

recipes.title: Service credits and concessions: revenue and billing impact
inputs: Invoices, credit memos and the revenue recognition schedule for the customer
Customer contract with the service level and credit terms
Correspondence granting or discussing the credits
Revised billing schedule
recipes.prompt: Review contractual service credits and concessions to determine their potential impact on revenue recognition and billing.

recipes.title: Internal software project costs: capitalization review
inputs: Projects and time entries for the quarter
General ledger for software development and payroll accounts
Project descriptions and stage documentation
Capitalization policy
recipes.prompt: Review internal software project costs and supporting descriptions for potential capitalization under the applicable accounting policy and guidance.

recipes.title: Intercompany service arrangements: recharge analysis
inputs: Intercompany relationships and balances matrix
Actual costs by entity and cost centre for the quarter
Intercompany service agreements
Cost allocation workbook
recipes.prompt: Review intercompany service arrangements and actual costs. Map the transaction flows and prepare a preliminary recharge accounting analysis.

recipes.title: Tax compliance status and evidence gaps by jurisdiction
inputs: Sales tax and VAT filings and jurisdiction settings
Sales transactions by jurisdiction for the quarter
Registration certificates and tax notices
Prior returns filed outside Dime
Compliance calendar
recipes.prompt: Review available tax registration notices, prior filings and transaction activity. Prepare a jurisdiction-specific compliance status and evidence gaps report.

recipes.title: Plain-language customer contract summary
inputs: Customer contract
recipes.prompt: Summarize the attached customer contract in plain language: what each side pays and when, term and renewal, termination rights, credits or discounts, and items to look into for revenue recognition.

setupQuestions.q: Which points should every contract summary cover beyond the standard ones (for example data protection, exclusivity, governing law)?

recipes.title: Draft capitalization and accrual threshold policy tested against the ledger
inputs: General ledger, profit and loss and balance sheet for the year
Firm policy template
recipes.prompt: Using this year's general ledger, draft a capitalization and accrual threshold policy: propose a materiality benchmark, test it against actual activity, and show how many items and dollars fall below the threshold.

setupQuestions.q: Which benchmarks should be considered (percent of revenue, of total assets, of pre-tax income) and at what percentages?
Is there a firm policy template the draft should follow (name or location)?

recipes.title: Duplicate vendor records with recommended merges or mapping corrections
inputs: Vendor list with tax IDs and contact details
Bills, payments and AP aging by vendor
recipes.prompt: Find duplicate vendor records and recommend merges or mapping corrections, with all affected transactions and open balances shown before changes.

setupQuestions.q: What makes two vendor records the same vendor (same tax ID, same bank details, same legal name) and which record survives?
Who approves vendor master changes?

recipes.title: Reclassifications for transactions coded against the mapping rules
inputs: Transactions for the month with account and department
Categorization rules in Dime
Mapping workbook (vendor and keyword to account and department)
recipes.prompt: Review transactions coded to the wrong department or account based on approved mapping rules and propose reclassifications.

setupQuestions.q: Where are the approved coding rules (vendor to account, vendor to department, keyword rules) and who approved them?

recipes.title: Recurring accrual, prepaid amortization and depreciation entries for the close
inputs: Recurring journal schedules
Prepaid amortization monthly summary
Fixed asset depreciation monthly summary
Journal entries already posted for the month
recipes.prompt: Prepare and propose all approved-policy recurring accrual, prepaid amortization and depreciation entries for the close period.

setupQuestions.q: Which recurring entries are approved (name, accounts, amount or source schedule, posting day)?
Which accruals reverse on the first day of the next month and which stay?

recipes.title: Unmatched customer receipts applied to open invoices
inputs: Bank and marketplace payout reports
Unmatched bank receipts and open invoices by customer
Remittance advices
recipes.prompt: Identify unmatched customer receipts and propose applying them to open invoices using remittance details.

setupQuestions.q: Within what amount may a receipt differ from the invoice and still be applied as full payment?
How are short payments handled (leave the balance open, write off under a limit, raise a credit memo)?

recipes.title: Intercompany differences from missing reciprocal postings with correcting entries
inputs: Intercompany balances matrix and reconciliation
Intercompany journal groups and the IC account ledgers per entity
recipes.prompt: Identify intercompany differences caused by missing reciprocal postings and propose correcting entries in the appropriate entities.

setupQuestions.q: Which entity pairs transact with each other?
Which ledger accounts are intercompany receivable and payable in each entity?
How are intercompany balances in different currencies translated and where do translation differences go?

recipes.title: Card transaction spreadsheet turned into journal entries
inputs: Card transaction spreadsheet
Chart of accounts and the card account ledger
recipes.prompt: Turn the attached card transaction spreadsheet into journal entries using its category column for the expense account, and propose them for the card account.

setupQuestions.q: Which chart-of-accounts name does each category in the spreadsheet map to?
Which liability account is the card?
Which account takes a line whose category is not in the map until a person decides?

recipes.title: Bank payments coded to expense that match an open bill, recoded against the bill
inputs: Open bills and the AP aging
Bank transactions coded to expense for the month
recipes.prompt: Find bank payments in the last closed month coded straight to expense that match an open bill in AP, and propose recoding them against the bill.

setupQuestions.q: Which accounts are accounts payable?
Which bank accounts are reconciled every month?

recipes.title: Daily integration exceptions digest
inputs: Integration status and event logs
recipes.prompt: Every business day, check for failed accounting integrations, missing postings, duplicate transactions and stale bank feeds. Send only actionable exceptions.

setupQuestions.q: Which integrations should be checked each day?
How many hours without a successful sync counts as stale?
Who receives digests and alerts?

recipes.title: Weekly controller digest
inputs: Cash forecast workbook kept outside Dime
recipes.prompt: Each week, review overdue receivables, upcoming payments, cash availability and forecast changes. Highlight items requiring action.

setupQuestions.q: Who receives digests and alerts?

recipes.title: Recurring vendor charges against contract terms
inputs: Vendor contract register
recipes.prompt: Each month, compare recurring vendor charges with contract terms and prior periods. Flag rate changes, duplicate invoices and unexpected fees.

recipes.title: Compliance deadlines and open requests tracker
inputs: Compliance calendar
recipes.prompt: Monitor upcoming compliance deadlines and open close or audit requests. Summarize overdue items and missing evidence each week.

recipes.title: Customers holding a prepayment and open AR, RD-2 Seed Co
recipes.prompt: Which customers held an unapplied prepayment or credit at 30 November 2026 and also had an open invoice on the same date? List each customer with both amounts and the invoice numbers. Entity: RD-2 Seed Co.
